instruction: Create systemd service for GoAccess dashboard
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/goaccess-dashboard.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=GoAccess Real-time Dashboard
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/goaccess /var/log/nginx/access.log --real-time-html --daemonize -o /var/www/html/report.html
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

instruction: Create Nginx config to serve GoAccess report
Create logrotate postrotate for fresh report
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/goaccess-postrotate << 'EOF'
/var/log/nginx/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/goaccess /var/log/nginx/access.log -a -o /var/www/html/report.html
    endscript
}
EOF
